presets.name: Blue hair catgirl · cheongsam · floor pose

She wears a white short-sleeve cheongsam-style top with red frog buttons and ruffled hem, sheer white thigh-high stockings. She lies on a dark polished wooden floor in a bright modern living room, large floor-to-ceiling windows with sheer curtains behind her, soft afternoon backlight, grey sofa and round gold table blurred in background. Extreme flexible contortion pose, low camera angle near floor level, full body in frame, photorealistic cosplay, anime-inspired face with realistic skin

presets.name: Blue hair maid · low angle · foot foreground
presets.positive: A cosplay photograph of a young woman with long wavy blue hair and straight bangs, white lace maid headband, subtle aquatic fin-like ears. Navy blue maid dress with white lace apron, keyhole chest cutout with gold buttons, navy bow with gold brooch, white lace cuffs, sheer white stockings. She sits on a light wooden floor, legs spread, one foot extremely close to camera creating strong foreshortening, low angle upward view. Bright backlit room with floor-to-ceiling sheer white curtains, soft diffused daylight, clean minimal interior, photorealistic cosplay photo, anime face proportions with realistic lighting and fabric
